title: Hijack/Quotes
kind: 場所・ミッション・その他

lines: - Lotus: "We are here to hijack the transport of a Fomorian Power core before it can be installed in the growing Fomorian fleet."
- Lotus: "A Fomorian Core is being transported from the factory for installation. You are here to make sure that core never reaches a Fomorian class ship."
- Lotus: "We need to take these cores into deep space for destruction. A core rupture here would turn this outpost into an uninhabitable wasteland."

- Lotus: "Left unchecked, Vay Hek will create hundreds of new Fomorian class ships. We plan to stop as many ships being built as possible by destroying their most critical components, the Fomorian Core."
- Lotus: "The Grineer are transporting the core by cargo tram. Find the control console to reroute the tram."
- Lotus: "Good, the tram has been rerouted. It will now draw power from your shields in order to keep moving forward."
- Lotus: "Excellent. We now have control of the tram. Its drive systems have been overriden and it will now draw power from your shields."
- Vay Hek: "What is happening? Where, where's the core?"
- Vay Hek: "Something's wrong. Tenno. Stop them!"
- Vay Hek: "What is happening to the tram? Investigate. Investigate now!"
- Vay Hek: "Assassins! Thieves! Miscreants! Leave my cores alone!"
- Vay Hek: "You are only delaying the inevitable. My Fomorians will be built. My ships will rule the system!"
- Vay Hek: "We will build the cores faster than you can destroy them Tenno. Mark my words."
- Vay Hek: "You cannot stop progress. All will be Grineer dominion!"
- Lotus: "Watch out for mines on the track. The enemy will use everything they can to stop us."
- Lotus: "Be careful. My scans show this track has been mined."
- Lotus: "The track has been mined. Proceed with caution."
- Lotus: "Get these doors open if you want to keep the core moving."
- Lotus: "The tram is not going anywhere until you get these doors open."
- Lotus: "They are trying to lock you in. Get the bay doors open."
- Lotus: "We are making progress. Stay sharp Tenno."
- Lotus: "So far so good. Keep moving the tram towards extraction."
- Vay Hek: "Come back with the core. OR DON'T COME BACK AT ALL!"
- Vay Hek: "Be warned, failure to stop the Tenno will result in your failure to continue breathing!"
- Vay Hek: "Stop them! Recover the cores!"
- Vay Hek: "Tenno? Tenno? Tenno are here! Stop them. Stop them at once!"
- Vay Hek: "Tenno have the core? They are not permitted to have the core!"
- Lotus: "You have reached the midpoint. Disposing of these cores will be a massive blow to Vay Hek."
- Lotus: "You are making solid progress. Keep moving."
- Lotus: "You are nearing extraction. This is the final push."
- Lotus: "Extraction is close. Do not let up. The Grineer must not be allowed to recover this core."
- Lotus: "Grineer have regained control of the tram."
- Lotus: "The Grineer have control and are pulling back the tram."
- Lotus: "The core is highly volatile. It will rupture if it takes too much damage. Do not let this happen."
- Lotus: "Protect the core. We will destroy it in space. The consequences of a rupture here are unthinkable."
- Lotus: "That core is taking heavy damage. If it ruptures, the ground you stand on will be uninhabitable for millenia."
- Lotus: "Protect the core from enemy fire. A rupture means certain death."
- Lotus: "The situation is desperate. If that core takes much more damage, it could wipe out you and this entire outpost."
- Lotus: "The core has almost ruptured. The situation is critical!"
- Lotus: "The core is rupturing. I am sorry Tenno. There is nothing I can do for you."
- Lotus: "A rupture is imminent. Tenno, you must prepare yourself for what comes next."
- Lotus: "The core has reached extraction. This is a major set back for Vay Hek."
- Lotus: "We have the core. The Grineer will not be pleased with our victory."
- Lotus: "We are here to hijack a Corpus Rover loaded with valuable cargo and escort it to our extraction point."
- Lotus: "Your target today is a Corpus Rover. Take control and escort the rover to extraction."
- Lotus: "The Corpus are trying to scavenge anything of value from these crashed ships. This Rover is carrying their most important finds."
- Lotus: "We have to move quickly, once the Corpus realize what we are trying to do, they will use everything they can to stop us."
- Lotus: "The rover is active but... wait... the Corpus have remotely corrupted its power cell. Hold on, I will reconfigure the rover to draw power from your shields."

- Lotus: "Good work we now have control of the rover... hold on Tenno... things just got more complicated. The Corpus have corrupted the rover's power-cell. I can reconfigure it but its new source of power will be your Warframe's shields."
- Lotus: "Keep going. That Rover's contents will be a huge boost to our cause."
- Lotus: "You have almost reached the extraction point. Keep fighting."
- Lotus: "The Corpus have regained control of the Rover."
- Lotus: "The Corpus are pulling back the Rover, you need to stay close to maintain control."
- Lotus: "The rover is reversing, get back in range as soon as possible."
- Lotus: "The rover is taking damage. The Corpus would rather destroy it that let us escape with its cargo."
- Lotus: "Protect the rover, if it's destroyed this mission will be considered a failure."
- Lotus: "The rover is taking heavy damage, you must protect it."
- Lotus: "Do not let the Corpus destroy the rover."
- Lotus: "Critical damage. The rover is almost destroyed."
- Lotus: "Situation critical. The rover must not take any more hits."
- Lotus: "The rover has been destroyed. This mission is over."
- Lotus: "They destroyed the rover. We're going home empty handed."
- Lotus: "Excellent. This cargo will be a big help to our cause."
